name: Planter Pot Clay
changes: WebP textures (512), meshopt-compressed; scaled to a 10 cm school flower pot and filled with soil in code (models/bio2/clay_pot.glb).

name: Periwinkle Plant (sadabahar, Catharanthus roseus): leaves and flowers
changes: Single leaves, yellow leaves and flowers cut out of the colour map (alpha from the black background), turned so the stalk points down and packed into bio2/sadabahar.webp and bio2/testleaf.webp; the potted plants, twigs, wilting, pale growth in the dark, white flowers and red-ink colouring are built in code.

name: Leaf 001
changes: Front side cut out with its opacity map into bio2/leaf_ovate.webp; used for the variegated plant (white margin and patches painted over the real leaf in code), bean seedlings and Hydrilla.

name: Transparent Slice of Sara Lee white whole grain bread
changes: Scaled to 384 px, WebP; the crumb is used as the top of the bread piece in the starch test (bio2/bread_slice.webp).

name: Red delicious, half
changes: Background removed, scaled, WebP; the top of the apple slice in the starch test (bio2/apple_half.webp).

name: Cucumber1
changes: Background removed, scaled, WebP; the cucumber slices of the starch and fat tests (bio2/cucumber_slice.webp).

name: Sunmaid-Raisin-Pile
changes: A patch of the pile cropped and scaled to a 256 px texture (bio2/raisin_skin.webp) for the wrinkled skin of the raisins.
